cases.answer: No. The review says establishing clinically relevant cut-offs is a key unresolved issue, that more data are needed and it is not in a position to define the most useful measure, especially across histologies. It proposes that histology-specific cutoffs be developed in future work. Existing cut-offs are described as arbitrary or study-specific.

cases.answer: The review reports ADAURA 5-year OS rates (median follow-up 59.9 months osimertinib, 56.2 months placebo). In stage II–IIIA: 85% with osimertinib vs 73% with placebo (HR 0.49; 95.03% CI 0.33–0.73; p<0.001). In the overall stage IB–IIIA population: 88% vs 78% (HR 0.49; 95.03% CI 0.34–0.70; p<0.001).

cases.answer: Versus White women, Black women had higher adjusted odds of dual screening vs neither (aOR 2.25) and of cervical-only vs neither (aOR 1.73), with no significant difference for CRC-only vs neither (1.58, CI 0.95–2.61). Hispanic women also had higher odds of dual screening (aOR 1.68) and cervical-only (aOR 2.34) vs neither, with no significant difference for CRC-only (1.42, CI 0.77–2.63). Compared with dual screening, Black women were less likely to have cervical-only screening (aOR 0.77), whereas Hispanic women were more likely to (aOR 1.39); neither differed significantly for CRC-only vs dual screening.

cases.answer: The Discussion proposes screening decisions are made at multiple levels driven by the woman's age: (2a) physician level (gynecologist vs primary care physician specialty influencing which screening is offered), (2b) patient level (e.g., menopause, reluctance for speculum exams, waiting until 65 when Medicare visits discuss CRC screening), and (2c) health system level (e.g., mailed FIT tests, available home-based tests and HPV testing).

cases.answer: No. The review is a narrative review and reports ADAURA results from the published phase 3 trial (cited as external references), not from a cohort the review itself enrolled. The ADAURA HRs (e.g., DFS HR 0.17 in stage II–IIIA; HR 0.20 in stage IB–IIIA; 5-year OS HR 0.49) are the trial's results.
